Fix: set direct_lemmas to 1 (or drop the theorem-scale shape / reclassify), and reword claim 1 and closed_by to say the parent's proof field is filled with a citation and the children are unformalised placeholders.

Move stated generally: goal_shape is 'a blueprint node whose proof is empty/partial and whose informal proof has N>=3 distinct steps', and use_when/avoid_when are general (README even generalises 'Gemini' to 'the LLM'). When-not-to-use and consequences are honest and specific: avoid_when grounds 'fewer than 3 steps -> refine' in the source (lines 496, 583) plus two honest inferred conditions; consequences admits each child's Gemini proof is a placeholder still to be formalised and lists grounded obligations (uses-consistency checklist lines 454/456) and concrete failure modes. On good leaves for a bounded prover it gives the right reason -- each leaf's uses cone is minimal (one definition plus one named sibling) and one step per lemma -- though it loosely says 'closes on its own' where the children are actually unformalised placeholders; the closed_by fields and consequences make that placeholder status clear, so it does not mislead.
